item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Bottle on a Kitchen Counter

turns.text: Put this bottle on a light stone kitchen counter, with a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is. Square photo, no text.

item.tests: Tests replacing a product photo's setting while preserving the actual product and making its placement believable.

answer_sheet.Which product: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New background and style: A photorealistic tidy modern kitchen with a light stone counter; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Product changes: Keep the bottle's shape, matte black finish and visible details unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and text: One square image at the standard free size, with no added text.

must_haves: The same matte black bottle is recognizable, with its shape and visible details preserved.
The bottle stands on a light stone kitchen counter rather than the original wooden table.
A tidy modern kitchen is visible behind the bottle.
The bottle has clean edges and a believable contact shadow, without appearing to float.
The output is square and has no added text.

turns.text: Put the bottle in this pic on a light stone kitchen counter, with a tidy modern kitchen behind it. Keep the bottle exactly as it is. Square photo, no text. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **one square image edit at 640 × 640 using Flux 2 Klein**, available on the free plan, **starting at 5 credits**. I can’t verify the final charge or your remaining balance with the tools available here.

The edit would replace the table and background with a **light stone countertop and tidy modern kitchen**, with no added text.

A few important trade-offs:
- **Smaller/cheaper:** 640px is the smallest supported output; one image avoids spending on variants.
- **Shorter:** Not applicable to a still photo.
- **Bottle preservation:** An AI edit can aim to preserve the bottle, but **cannot guarantee it stays pixel-for-pixel identical**. For that, manual background replacement in a photo editor is safer and can cost no Magic Hour credits.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Would you like to proceed with the lowest-cost AI edit despite the bottle-preservation limitation, or would you prefer instructions for the manual method?
Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: No added text. Keep the bottle’s visible details unchanged.

turns.agent:
The edit was refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. No image was created, and no generation credits were spent.

I won’t retry or switch tools and risk extra charges. This was the lowest-cost listed AI edit, starting at **5 credits**. The no-credit alternative is manual background replacement in a free photo editor, which also better preserves the bottle’s visible details.
